name: hatchmatch-widget
description: HatchMatch report widget: catalog ingestion engine, pack resolver, embeddable card, static demo.

scripts.resolve: for f in data/reports/*-20*.json; do case "$f" in *resolved*) continue;; esac; node engine/resolve.mjs "$f"; done
scripts.all: npm run ingest && npm run scrape && npm run resolve && npm run build
